name: Kyoumou no Santa Katalina
original_name: 虚妄のサンタ・カタリナ
source:
A certain era. A certain country.
There was a boy named Joachim there.
Everyone loved him, for he was very gentle and very brave.
He was a very "good person".

A certain season. A certain village.
A merchant named Enzo came there.
Everyone loved him, for he was very energetic and very bright.
He was a very "good person".

The two boys quickly became friends.

A certain day. A certain place.
Suddenly, many children disappeared.
The gentle boy disappeared as well, and the merchant boy was very worried.
Half a year later he returned safely,
but told no one where he'd been or what he'd done.

The other children never returned at all.

[Translated from the [url=https://mamemaru092.wixsite.com/mamemaru09/複製-サンタ-ピエラの平和な世界]official site[/url]]
translation:
某个时代。某个国家。
那里有一个名叫约阿希姆的男孩。
每个人都喜欢他，因为他非常温柔而且非常勇敢。
他是一个非常“好人”。

某个季节。某个村庄。
一位名叫恩佐的商人来到了那里。
每个人都喜欢他，因为他非常有活力，非常聪明。
他是一个非常“好人”。

这两个男孩很快就成了朋友。

某一天。某个地方。
突然，许多孩子消失了。
温柔的男孩也消失了，商人男孩很担心。
半年后他平安归来，
但没有告诉任何人他去过哪里或做了什么。

其他孩子再也没有回来。

【翻译自[url=https://mamemaru092.wixsite.com/mamemaru09/複製-サンタ-ピエラの平和な世界]官网[/url]】
